name: aks-rp-e2e-regular-learning
description: Wake aks-rp-e2e for safe regular learning work only: source inventory, spec extraction, model validation, and generated views. No cloud mutation.

handler.task:
project: /app/projects/aks-rp-e2e
agent: aks-explorer
goal: Run the regular learning lane only. Read project.md, knowledge-map/README.md, and execution/automation.md. Process at most one safe non-cloud model/spec/source-inventory task, validate the knowledge map, regenerate views if needed, and write evidence/status. Do not run az, kubectl, --execute, staging, standalone, cluster creation, or cloud mutation.
maxIterations: 1
reviewEvery: 1

name: aks-rp-e2e-weekly-replan-review
description: Review stale unknown paths and replanning candidates. Proposal/model work only unless a tracked run plan is already explicitly gated.

handler.task:
project: /app/projects/aks-rp-e2e
agent: aks-explorer
goal: Review replanning candidates and stale unknown normalized paths. Read project.md, knowledge-map/views/path-summary.json, run-plans/README.md, and execution/automation.md. Produce one bounded proposal, model hygiene update, or next-action artifact. Do not run cloud probes unless project.md already names a ready gated verification task with explicit owner authorization.
maxIterations: 1
reviewEvery: 1

name: aks-rp-e2e-verification-signal
description: Manual/event trigger for one ready verification run plan. It is intentionally not interval-based.

handler.task:
project: /app/projects/aks-rp-e2e
agent: aks-explorer
goal: Process one ready regular verification lane item from project.md. Require a feature packet, run plan, probe check, clean preflight, explicit probe-specific cloud mutation gate if mutating, cleanup plan, and named evidence files. If any gate is missing, write a blocker or next-action artifact instead of executing.
maxIterations: 1
reviewEvery: 1
